sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section I, List of Answers on Terminology 23

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section I, List of Answers on Terminology 23:1
items.html: A lower degree sometimes rises to a level equal with the one above it, at a time when the upper one needs it for its own completion. The lower one is then discerned as the discernment of left, and the upper one as the discernment of right.
